faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER TVM) for their research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IISER TVM?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the MoE-STARS funded project at the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment announcement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc in Physics or Materials Science with a minimum of 60% marks and must have qualified in a national-level examination like CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, JEST, or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants interested in the Junior Research Fellow position is 25 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37000 along with applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IISER TVM Junior Research Fellow recruitment is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IISER TVM Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their applications online by filling out the Google form link provided in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this research position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and working experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and online application link?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification details, advertisement reference, and direct application links in the Important Links section of this article.
